name: Houjou Hana
source: The Student Council's Vice President, a third-year who comes from a long line of Isshiki family retainers. Together with her twin, Hana devoted herself to supporting Kaname. Behind her sunny disposition lies a backbone of steel - she'll stand her ground against anyone.
